name: EditDefora Editor Default Opener
author: samiur6688

sections.description:
EditDefora Editor Default Opener allows you to choose a specific plugin to open by default when accessing the WordPress Plugin Editor.

By default, WordPress opens the first plugin in the Plugin Editor’s list, which is generally determined by alphabetical order. This plugin provides a simple way to select the plugin you want to open instead.

Using the plugin, you can:

  • Select a plugin to open by default in the Plugin Editor.
  • Change the selected default plugin at any time.
  • Access the settings from Plugins → EditDefora Editor Default Opener.

Features include:

  • Select a default plugin for the WordPress Plugin Editor.
  • Simple single-page settings interface.
  • Conveniently accessible from the Plugins admin menu.
  • Lightweight and focused functionality.
  • No external services or data collection.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the editdefora-editor-default-opener folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Plugins → EditDefora Editor Default Opener.
  4. Select the plugin you want to open by default in the Plugin Editor.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
What does EditDefora Editor Default Opener do?

EditDefora Editor Default Opener allows you to select which plugin should open by default when you access the WordPress Plugin Editor.

Why do I need this plugin?

WordPress normally opens the first plugin in the Plugin Editor’s list. This plugin allows you to choose a different plugin as the default instead of relying on the alphabetical order.

Can I change the default plugin?

Yes. You can change the selected plugin at any time from the Plugins → EditDefora Editor Default Opener settings page.

Does the plugin modify my plugin files?

No. EditDefora Editor Default Opener does not modify the files of the selected plugin. It only controls which plugin is selected when opening the Plugin Editor.

Does the plugin collect or send data to external services?

No. EditDefora Editor Default Opener does not connect to external services or send your website data elsewhere.
